caption: The drawing is composed of a grid-like arrangement of squares, each containing individual illustrations outlined in fine lines with subtle pastel hues of red, blue, green, brown, pink, and yellow. The majority of the squares feature botanical motifs such as various flowers, leaves, and fruiting branches. Other squares depict different animals, including cats, a dog, a bird, and a butterfly, as well as two horses and a rooster. Some squares represent scenes with human figures, including men and women in period attire, a bust of a man with facial hair, and a group of two people standing together. Two prominent illustrated faces appear in portrait style, one on each side of the grid. Additional elements include representations of windmills, a rural house, a pair of American flags, a mushroom, and floral wreaths. The central section of the composition is surrounded by a border patterned with small flowers and features larger illustrations including an angel or cherub with wings, the aforementioned American flags, a butterfly, and combined botanical and animal motifs. The colors and linework are softly applied, giving an even visual texture to the composition, which is bordered with pale blue lines separating each individual square or rectangle.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
